name: Night of the Idle Horde
summary: Eat the world in this idle, incremental homage to B-movie horror classics. Start as a lowly Shambler and grow into a massive horde. Recruit evil little critters to automate brain collection and buy upgrades for your army. Unleash a mini apocalypse with Desktop Companion Mode.
